database.db_helpers module

db_helpers.py Reusable functions for connecting to and disconnecting from PostgreSQL.

database.db_helpers.connect_db(database_url: str)[source]

Connect to the PostgreSQL database described by database_url.

Parameters:

database_url (str) – A “postgresql://user:password@host:port/dbname” connection string.

Returns:

The open connection, or None if the connection failed.

Return type:

psycopg.Connection or None

database.db_helpers.disconnect_db(conn)[source]

Close a database connection opened by connect_db.

Parameters:

conn (psycopg.Connection or None) – The connection to close, or None.

Returns:

None.

Return type:

None

database.db_helpers.get_applicant(conn, p_id)[source]

Query a single row from the applicants table by its primary key.

Parameters:

  • conn (psycopg.Connection) – An open database connection.

  • p_id (int) – The applicant’s primary key.

Returns:

A dict keyed by column name, or None if no row has that p_id.

Return type:

dict or None

database.db_helpers.pretty_print_query(query)[source]

Format a SQL query so each clause or special keyword (SELECT, FROM, WHERE, GROUP BY, AND, etc.) starts its own line and is written in uppercase.

Parameters:

query (str) – The SQL query to format.

Returns:

The formatted query string.

Return type:

str
